title: Phase 4 verdict — the last thing the fleet emits
description: Produced by the review gate. This is the document a human reads to decide whether to ship. It is deliberately hostile: its job is to find reasons NOT to ship, and 'everything passed' must be earned rather than assumed.

decisionCompliance.description: Re-run independently of each lane's self-report. The gate's verdict wins over the lane's.

agentsMdInSync.description: Every record in backlog/decisions/ appears in the AGENTS.md checklist, and nothing superseded is listed as binding. This went stale for eight days once already.

demos.description: One entry per feature built. A feature with no demo BLOCKS the verdict.

skipsObserved.description: Must be zero. Run with REQUIRE_DB=1; a skip is a failure, because 'passed' and 'never ran' are otherwise indistinguishable.

pilotExitCriteria.description: Scored against backlog/milestones/m-5 - vienna-pilot.md. Honest partials are expected — two criteria REQUIRE physical hardware and ten calendar days and cannot be satisfied by any amount of agent work.

verdict.description: BLOCK if any decision violation, any missing or failing demo, any non-zero skip count, or any lane reporting BLOCKED.

handoffMemoPath.description: Where the next session picks up. Required regardless of verdict.
